We are now ready to present the main results of this paper. We establish target reachability by combining two ingredients: local control actions that reduce an energybased distance to the target, and recurrence of the zeroinput Hamiltonian flow, which returns trajectories to regions where those actions can be reused. Repeating this interplay allows the trajectory to reach the target energy band and, ultimately, the target set. This separation between controlled energy reduction and passive recurrence underlies all results in this section.
